data.description: Architectural Icon | Private Pool | Wellness-Focused Living
data.display_address: Samana SKy Views, Dubai Production City (IMPZ), Dubai
data.long_description:
Make a bold statement with your new home in Samana Sky Views, where eye-catching architecture meets smart, functional design. Nestled between Dubai South and Jumeirah Golf Estates, this project offers excellent connectivity while maintaining a peaceful, community-focused atmosphere. The development stands tall with 21 residential floors and multiple basement levels.

Each unit includes a private pool on the balcony, giving you your own private resort experience right at home. Large balconies, open views, and well-lit interiors provide a perfect mix of comfort and modern aesthetics. It’s a space built for both relaxation and everyday living.

The building includes a curated list of amenities for wellness and entertainment, including a pilates/dance studio, jogging trails, steam and sauna rooms, and more. Families will love the kids' play area and on-site nursery, while professionals can enjoy serene evenings in the outdoor lounge or host guests in the event space.
